title: Arabian Checkmate Explained
transcript: One minute chess lesson. Let's go. This is the Arabian checkmate. It's considered to be one of the earliest checkmates ever discovered when chess was invented. This happens when the king is in the corner. There is a knight two diagonal steps away from it and you have a rook that can deliver a checkmate with the knight like this. So now let's try to solve some Arabian checkmate puzzles. First level here we have a king close to the corner. We have a rook and we have a knight that can reach the position two steps diagonally away from the king. So we start with knight f6 check. The king can only go here and we can now deliver our Arabian checkmate. In this next puzzle, we can see that the king is already in the corner and we have the knight two diagonal steps away from it. So now how can we get this rook to this square to deliver the checkmate. If we think like that, we can find the move queen takes a5 check, forcing black to take that pawn and delivering checkmate like this. So now you know how the Arabian checkmate works.
